name: animated-attachment
title: Animated Attachment
description: File chips that show upload progress, errors and previews.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The drop zone, border trace and progress take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the chosen palette.

props.name: animateEnter
props.label: Animate enter
props.description: New files scale up and fade into the list.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Gap between files added together, in seconds.

props.name: flyIn
props.label: Fly in from drop
props.description: Dropped files fly from where they were dropped into the list.

props.name: animatedBorder
props.label: Animated border
props.description: The drop zone's border marches while a file is dragged over it.

props.name: animateExit
props.label: Animate exit
props.description: Removed files shrink out and the rest slide together.

props.name: rollingNumbers
props.label: Rolling numbers
props.description: Upload percentages roll to each new number.

props.name: shimmerText
props.label: Shimmer text
props.description: A light sweeps across the file name while it uploads.

props.name: borderTrace
props.label: Border trace
props.description: A line traces around the card as it uploads.

props.name: fill
props.label: Card fill (images)
props.description: Image cards fill up with the picture as they upload.

props.name: fillDirection
props.label: Fill direction
props.description: Which way the image fill grows. Needs Card fill on.

props.name: shakeOnError
props.label: Shake on error
props.description: A file that fails shakes: a random failure, or one that is too big or the wrong type.

props.name: revealAction
props.label: Reveal action
props.description: The remove button appears only on hover or focus (pointer devices).

props.name: zoomOnHover
props.label: Zoom on hover
props.description: Image previews zoom in slightly on hover.

props.name: blurUntilLoaded
props.label: Blur while uploading
props.description: Image previews stay blurred while they upload and process.

props.name: expandable
props.label: Expandable preview
props.description: Clicking an image opens it in a large preview.

props.name: reorder
props.label: Drag to reorder
props.description: Drag files sideways to reorder them.

props.name: tiltOnScroll
props.label: Tilt on scroll
props.description: Cards lean as the row is scrolled sideways. Needs Wrap off.

props.name: wrap
props.label: Wrap
props.description: Files wrap onto new lines instead of scrolling in one row.

props.name: simulateFailures
props.label: Simulate failures
props.description: Some uploads fail at random, to preview the error state.

props.name: maxSizeMB
props.label: Max file size
props.description: Files bigger than this show an error card instead of uploading.

props.name: accept
props.label: Accepted files
props.description: Which files can be added. Others show an error card, and the file picker only offers these.
